name: Data Browser Process Quality Control (Web)
implementation_notes: ProcessQualityControlRecordService/Controller/routes/factories/StationFactory state are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Process Quality Control screens (100/110/120), mirroring ClarificationRecordService's precedent -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence. ProcessQualityControlRecord/ProcessQualityControlDetail models and migrations were already generated in an earlier (Phase 1/entity-catalog) pass per the task brief; this pass used the existing model/migration column list as ground truth for the service/factories and found them consistent, requiring no changes

Process Quality Control follows the same hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row, 1..24 rows, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) pattern as Clarification/Boiler Room/Engine Room -- create()/update()/listRecords()/export()/getDetail(), plus canonicalTimeSlots() helper returning 24 'HH:00' strings starting 07:00, mirroring mobile's processQualityControlRecordRepo.ts

THE STATION WITH THE MOST NON-TIME_SLOT COLUMNS IN THE PROJECT (16): DETAIL_FIELDS = ['shift', 'qc_inspector_id', ...READING_FIELDS] with READING_FIELDS = 12 numeric readings + qc_engineering_corrective_actions + findings (14 total) -- shift and qc_inspector_id are identifying/context columns excluded from filled_slot_count/minimum-one-row validation, mirroring ProcessWaterRecordService's shift/inspector_id exclusion exactly (a new derived pattern, since Clarification itself has no identifying columns to exclude)

UNLIKE Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant: Process Quality Control has NO operational-target reference table -- no seeder, no model, no Target Operasional section anywhere in this station's 6 screens, per this task's explicit scope

The Process Quality Control tile in production-process-activity.blade.php (screen-035) was updated from a javascript:void(0) placeholder to route('data.process-quality-control') -- this was the LAST remaining unrouted tile; 0 now remain

tests/Feature/ProductionProcessActivityTest.php updated: the 'still-unrouted' test (previously asserting 1 remaining tile) was replaced -- the single 'berhasil' test now asserts all 17 active station tiles render with real route() hrefs, and a new assertDontSee('javascript:void(0)') confirms no placeholder links remain, since the scenario it used to cover became vacuous once Process Quality Control was routed

StationFactory::processQualityControl() state added additively (mirrors clarification()/boilerRoom()/engineRoom()/storageTank()/effluentPlant() exactly) for this screen's and screen-120's test suites -- this is the FINAL station-type factory state added across all 10 of the 2026-08-31 batch

Ran the full backend test suite (`php artisan test`) after implementation: 2148 passed, 0 failed. Process-Quality-Control-specific tests (`--filter=ProcessQualityControl`): 86 passed (0 failed) -- 29 unit (ProcessQualityControlRecordServiceTest, reported under this screen), 7 integration (Feature/Api/DataBrowserProcessQualityControlTest), 5 component (Feature/Livewire/DataBrowserProcessQualityControlTest); remaining 45 Process Quality Control tests reported under screen-110/screen-120 below; ProductionProcessActivityTest (5 tests, project-level not station-specific) also passes

deferred_items.description: The mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button (Station List, screen-006) does not push locally-entered Process Quality Control records to POST /api/process-quality-control-records -- unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water/Kernel Dispatch/CPO Dispatch/Effluent Plant/Storage Tank/Engine Room/Boiler Room/Clarification, which each have a syncProcessQualityControlRecords()-equivalent function wired into syncService.ts's syncAllRecords().
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Clarification) made the same deferral for the same reason. The route itself is already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role, see routes/api.php) so this is purely a mobile syncService.ts addition, not a backend change, when picked up later.
